title: Dig a Dakota hole
kid_text: A fire in a hole stays out of the wind.
safety: A hole fire is still a fire. Clear the grass around it.

steps.text: Dig a pit about as wide as your boot.
Dig a second hole on the wind side.
Join the holes with a low tunnel.
Clear dry grass back from both holes.

mistakes.text: You block the air hole with wood.

mistakes.fix: Use bare dirt, not peat or duff.
